integrity: The infinite claim follows from Newton interpolation, the published local zero/nonzero criterion, and a new carry-count argument with constructive witnesses. Integer-arithmetic checks reproduce all inspected finite instances but are not used as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the full binomial progression with lower index k>=2; does not cover truncated progression gcds or other lower-index selections. Unindexed earlier work remains a possible originality risk.
title: Exact prime-power factorization of the binomial progression gcd
